# Feature Request

Thank you for suggesting a feature for the FastPix Video WordPress plugin.

Describe the feature and explain how it would improve the plugin.

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem

Describe the problem this feature would solve.

Example: "I'm unable to..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented.

<!-- For example: a new block or shortcode attribute, a player option, a library filter or bulk
     action, an analytics metric, support for another LMS or consent plugin, a WP-CLI command,
     or a new hook/filter for developers. -->

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

<!-- Including whether this belongs in the plugin or in the FastPix platform itself: encoding,
     delivery, DRM and data collection run on FastPix. The plugin is the WordPress side — admin
     screens, embedding, access checks, local analytics and LMS integration. -->

## Use Case

Describe how you would use this feature.

Include the type of site (courses, membership, publisher, marketing, live events), any related
plugins, and whether it affects editors, site owners or visitors.

## Impact

Who would benefit from this feature?

- [ ] Most users
- [ ] Some users
- [ ] My site only

## Priority

How important is this feature to your workflow?

- [ ] Critical
- [ ] High
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] Low

## Additional Context

Provide any additional information, examples, or mockups that help explain the feature request.
